mode.description: The `compatibilityMode` setting (15 for Word 2013 and later, 14, 12 or 11), or `null` when the document has none.

options.description: The legacy compatibility options it switches on, by element name, sorted.

ground_truth.description: Whether Word ground truth exists for it.

license.description: The SPDX license expression under which the corpus redistributes it; `NOASSERTION` for private documents.

page_count.description: Its page count in Word, once ground truth exists (LAB-002); `null` until then.

provenance.description: Where it was found: at least one source, the first being the one whose license applies.

scan.description: What the tagger found; `null` until the document is tagged.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the document's bytes: its identity, and its key in the store.

GroundTruth.description: Whether Word ground truth exists for a document (LAB-002 fills it in).

word_build.description: The Word build that produced it, once produced.

GroundTruthStatus.description: The ground-truth status of a document.

oneOf.description: Produced by the Word build in [`GroundTruth::word_build`].
Word could not produce it (the harness logs why).

LicenseText.description: A license or notice file of a source.

path.description: The file's path in the source, such as `LICENSE`.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the file, under which the store keeps it.

path.description: The document's path in the source. Never recorded for private documents, whose file names can reveal personal data.

source.description: The name of a source in [`Manifest::sources`].

Scan.description: What the tagger found in a document.

application.description: The application that last saved it, from its application properties.

features.description: The coverage-matrix features the document uses, by their names in the matrix, sorted.

languages.description: The language tags it declares, sorted.

pages_hint.description: The page count that application recorded: a hint until Word's own count is known.

scripts.description: Characters per script in its text.

tagger.description: The version of the tagging rules that produced this ([`TAGGER_VERSION`]).

Sha256.description: A SHA-256 digest: 64 lower-case hexadecimal digits.

Source.description: Where documents come from, described once for all of them.

copyright.description: The copyright notice of the source, as its license file states it.

license.description: The SPDX license expression under which the source distributes its documents.

license_texts.description: The source's license and notice files, which the store keeps by SHA-256 so the corpus can be redistributed with them.

notes.description: Why the license applies to the documents, and anything else a reviewer should know.

revision.description: The exact revision the documents were taken from, such as a full Git commit hash.

url.description: Where the source can be found, such as a repository's HTTPS address.

Tier.description: The corpus tiers of the Fidelity Lab specification (§3).

oneOf.description: Probes: small generated documents, each isolating one behavior.
Public: real or realistic documents with redistributable licenses.
Private: real-world documents that are never redistributed.
Torture: known-hard documents, public or private as their licenses allow.

sources.description: The sources of the documents, by name.

version.description: The version of the manifest's layout; this is version 1.
